entities.name: FtsH ATP-dependent protease
observations: The 634-aa query has 66.5–71.2% identity and 94.8–98.6% query coverage to reviewed bacterial FtsH homologs, supporting FtsH identity.
Reviewed FtsH annotations describe a membrane-associated, ATP-dependent zinc metalloprotease involved in cytoplasmic and membrane-protein quality control.
Sequence-derived length is 634 aa and estimated molecular mass is 69,908 Da; pI is 5.57.
